notes.title: Localization Update
notes.notes:
It's time to have Voidborn being played all over the place!

We have partnered up with The Bueno Lab to launch the localized version of Voidborn, now the game includes the following new languages:

French

Italian

German

Spanish - Spain

Simplified Chinese

Traditional Chinese

Korean

Japanese

Russian

notes.title: THANKS FOR PLAYING! (Also, game update 1.01)
notes.notes:
THANK YOU SO MUCH!
Hey hey, what a week! We are super happy everyone's been enjoying the game, you can bet we couldn't be happier!


Game Changes
With that said, we did notice some dialogue bugs avoided our void sword wrath, but we squashed them now! (Hopefully) - Now go get that Aching Ear achievement!
Also, some of you requested for resolution options as well as FPS lock, so we've also made some changes on that front!

Full patch notes


 Now the game can be played in two different resolutions: 1920x1080 and 1280x720
 Now you can lock the FPS in 30, 60 or 120
 Fixed an error where the elemental sword dialogues wouldn't be loaded in certain situations 
 Fixed an error where one of the upgrade dialogue wouldn't be loaded in certain situations 
 Some dialogue can re-appear if any of the conversations weren't read
 Fixed issue where steam deck cloud save wouldn't load properly
 Fixed issue where a specific dialogue would block new dialogues from appearing

notes.title: Demo Update 2
notes.notes:
Greetings from the Void!

You've been saying, we've been listening! So here's one more update for ya'll!

Big Ol'Betty (Miniboss)
We've dumbed down Big Ol'Betty juuuuust a little, making it easier for you starboys to dodge!

 She stops following the player at the end of her aiming


Shops, Upgrades and Looting
We've also heard loud and clear: The two-currency paradigm is not working. So, let's fix that:

 There's a single currency now



That's it, I hope you're all enjoying our demo! And feel free to give any feedbacks, all are welcome!

See you Across the Abyss!

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
Greetings from the Void!
In our first update for our demo, we heard that those pesky babysharks were a little too much caffeinated... So we did something about it, while also reducing a little the number of babysharks that go after your buttocks:

Babyshark
• Move speed reduced by 10%
• Damage reduced by 50%
• Reduced quantity spawned by ~5%

Since we reduced damage on the babysharks, we also polished the edges of our neutral probe, hurting less when they touch you! We also stuffed them with more organic matter to facilitate your first upgrades while you're not eviscerating those pesky Babysharks later in the level!

Neutral Probe
• Damage (on touch) reduced by 50%
• Organic resources drop ~60% more often
• Inorganic resources drop ~20% less often

This should provide a less punishing experience in the beggining, and accelerate the rate which you upgrade your capabilities, smoothing the difficulty curve!

Thanks for playing our demo and feel free to leave any feedbacks!

See you Across the Abyss!
